G-DESIGN.description: Evaluate the versioned source-backed design, explicit limitations, source/PR/issue linkage, tasks and model-role recommendation. This is design self-analysis, not independent implementation review. Record the actual planning-deliverable decision at AC01.

G-DEPTH.description: Implementation pending. Require shared painted-camera departure breakup, forward flight-through, safe near-plane behavior and incoming emergence from a real scene anchor. Inspect source-bound two-sided clips in both route directions and nonadjacent navigation. Preserve current fractal/formula/room geometry and active no-ribbons composition; this user amendment deliberately changes settled camera policy, not world geometry. Native overlay depth is provisional until visual admission.

G-FIDELITY.description: Implementation pending. Require mixed-mask text/image coverage on both outgoing actual viewport and incoming actual landing, exact native final layout, safe SVG/crop/alpha and Day/Night desktop/narrow handoff evidence. Missing images or word-only motion cannot satisfy this gate.

G-NAVIGATION.description: Implementation pending. Run real fragment transaction, interruption, native bottom/hash/filter/history and cleanup tests. Preserve deliberate edge input, tails, Credits instant behavior and proposed existing reverse direction. Review always-forward Back separately if requested; no new choreography is inferred.

G-ACCESSIBILITY.description: Implementation is pending. Check final semantic/native behavior, inert inaccessible visual copies, focus, announcements, no duplicate live identities, Off/reduced/hidden/print/failure and zero retained fragment resources.

G-PERFORMANCE.description: Implementation pending. Enforce one combined departure/arrival resource cap and compare same-source stationary-camera legacy presentation versus stationary-camera fragments at identical quality/cache/landing conditions. Retain raw inclusive timing/layout/paint/resource evidence and all original budgets. Camera-policy savings cannot mask fragment cost. No measurement is made in this planning revision; release/native/device gates retain their owners.

G-DELIVERY.description: Require implemented named checks for AC02-AC08, canonical/generated/offline and RI/profile updates, CS01-CS10 evidence including substantive review, current-source scoped CI/preview/staging, author visual acceptance, independent implementation review, actual checkboxes and final maintainer merge/main gate. Planning publication is not feature completion or production authorization.

G-READING.description: Implementation pending. Verify fixed settled route camera through real native scroll, Writing filtering, layout/font/image changes, resize/zoom, anchors and history restoration. Preserve actual scroll endpoints, edge-triggered route flights, living ambient scene and Off/reduced/hidden/print semantics. Inspect thematic framing including Writing formula; do not hide missing camera work by disabling Motion.
